{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for: completed orders AND loyal customers
filtered = sales[
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Number of completed, loyal orders: {len(filtered)}")
print(f"Mean revenue (USD): {mean_revenue}")"}
